service.name: Voice-fronted cover band
service.serviceType: Voice-fronted covers for private and corporate events
service.description: Covers fronted by Tejas Singh, booked as a duo, trio or quartet for private and corporate events in Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: How does the duo to quartet ladder work on one contract?
faqs.a: One act books at every size the night needs: a duo through arrival, cocktails and dinner, then the rhythm section arrives and the same voice fronts the dance floor. One contract, one load-in, one sound check, and no seam in the middle of the night for guests to hear.

The dance floor. At quartet the same voice fronts guitar, bass, drums and keys or a second guitar, playing a covers set built for a floor. Dinner holds at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, the floor runs 88 to 95, and the quartet moves between the two on cue rather than on a clock.

Covers, fronted by one voice. The style is singer-songwriter covers, and the set pulls from the published song list, which runs to 240 titles. A set is built against your run of show and read song by song on the night, and the first learned song you choose is included in every booking.

faqs.q: Does the duo work for a wedding cocktail hour?
faqs.a: Yes. The duo covers arrival, cocktails and dinner at a volume guests talk across, and it is the pick when the hour wants a voice out front rather than an instrumental set. A single hour is priced on its own line of the rate card, and the same act can grow to the quartet later on the same contract.
